questions.subject: BUSINESS_ENTREPRENEURSHIP
questions.stem: Quillpeak wants to treat a worker making yoga equipment as an independent contractor. Which factor most strongly indicates employee status instead?

options.text: The worker uses their own tools and sets their own hours
The company controls when, where, and how the work is done
The worker is paid per completed deliverable
The worker serves several clients at once

questions.explanation: The degree of control over how, when, and where work is performed is central to distinguishing employees from contractors. Control by the hiring firm points to employment, while independence, own tools, and multiple clients point to contracting.
questions.hint: Control over the details of work is the key test.
